title: Desperate Escape
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao brought Chen Ji to the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, her expression unprecedentedly grave under the moonlight: "Chen Ji, do you know what kind of existence you've provoked?"

text.content: The black-clad man's blade light tore through the night sky, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—yet just as the fatal strike was about to fall, a faint glow suddenly emanated from his wrist, and a familiar demonic path aura burst forth like ghostly fire in the darkness. "It's you..." The black-clad man's blade momentum faltered, shock flickering in his eyes. Chen Ji sneered inwardly—this was his last hidden trump card—the demonic path brand from Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice rang in his mind) "North, a fork in three breaths, turn left." Chen Ji had no time to think, his body instinctively racing northward. He knew this was the lifeline Ye Qing was creating for him through the demonic path mist. Behind him, the black-clad man's blade aura followed like a shadow, tearing at the back of his robes.

text.content: Three breaths passed, Chen Ji turned left without hesitation. A low curse came from behind the black-clad man, clearly the opponent hadn't expected him to accurately predict the escape route. "A mere waste, yet you have such fortune..." The black-clad man's voice grew increasingly cold, "Do you think you can escape?" The blade light approached again, Chen Ji's back had already been slashed by the blade aura, blood staining his green robes.

The pain coursed through his entire body like lightning, yet Chen Ji gritted his teeth, his mind racing. The Tianji Record Fragment deep in his consciousness flickered with faint light—it could foresee three hours into the future, but the cost was 5 points of Heavenly Fate. At this moment, he was severely wounded—if he used the Tianji Record again... "No." He forcibly suppressed the thought, saving it for the most critical moment.

choice.prompt: At this life-and-death moment, Chen Ji had to make a decision—continue relying on Ye Qing's guidance to flee, or risk using the Tianji Record's foresight?

choices.description: Ye Qing's demonic path brand had already saved him twice; he should continue relying on her guidance rather than consuming precious Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: The wound on his back continues bleeding, his stamina dropping rapidly
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, maintain the tacit cooperation with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing's guidance is wrong or the black-clad man catches up, he will fall into a desperate situation

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the urge to use the Tianji Record, fully trusting the demonic voice in his mind. "Twenty zhang ahead, there's an abandoned well, jump in!" Ye Qing's voice was urgent and firm. Chen Ji didn't hesitate, his toes touched the ground, his figure ghost-like as he rushed toward the well hidden by overgrown weeds—

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to predict
choices.description: The black-clad man's strength far exceeds expectations; only the Tianji Record's complete foresight can show him the true path to survival, even at the cost of Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete foresight of escape route, including all variables
choices.risk_hint: Exhausting Heavenly Fate will trigger a fatal backlash of destiny

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, the Tianji Record Fragment at his brow center suddenly grew scalding hot. A mysterious rune appeared before his eyes—the next three hours unfolded like a carousel of visions. He saw three ambush points, two escape routes, and... an unexpected figure.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji leaped toward the abandoned well, a sharp sword light slashed from the side! "Clang—" In the clash of metal, the black-clad man's blade was forcibly deflected. Chen Ji took this momentary breather to flip into the well, yet on the well wall he distinctly saw a familiar sword mark—the unique marker of Tianqing Sect's Inner Sect sword technique.

dialogue.content: "Waste is waste, even escape requires someone to save you." A cold voice came from the well opening. Chen Ji looked up—under the moonlight, a white-robed figure stood proudly on the well's edge, sword pointing at the black-clad man. Su Qingyao! Her gaze swept over Chen Ji's bedraggled appearance, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes, "Next time you're being chased, don't die outside and disgrace Tianqing Sect."

text.content: The black-clad man steadied himself, his eyes beneath the mask as gloomy as an abyss: "Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao? Tianqing Sect's hand extends a bit too far, doesn't it?" Su Qingyao coldly laughed, the sword's cold light surging: "Chasing my sect's disciples on Tianqing Sect's territory, did you ask my sword?" Before the words finished, she had already transformed into a white rainbow, her sword light directly aiming for the black-clad man's throat!

Chen Ji leaned against the well wall, catching his breath, yet his gaze never left the battle above. Su Qingyao's swordsmanship was fierce and unmatched, each strike carrying the dominance befitting an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. However, the black-clad man's movement was bizarrely agile, actually managing to evade all fatal attacks within the flicker of lightning. The battle's aftermath caused pebbles to rattle down the well walls.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao was locked in fierce combat with the black-clad man, but Chen Ji noticed the black-clad man seemed to be stalling for time—he had to make a choice.

choices.description: Chen Ji saw through the black-clad man's intentions, chose to trust Su Qingyao, and shared his discovery with her to jointly face the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of his perceptive abilities, arousing Su Qingyao's suspicion
choices.visible_reward: Speed up the battle's conclusion, avoiding more variables
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might interrogate him about why he could see through the situation

dialogue.content: "He's waiting for reinforcements!" Chen Ji shouted loudly, his voice piercing through the night wind. Su Qingyao's eyes hardened, her sword technique abruptly changed, no longer holding back. In an instant, sword light poured like the Milky Way, completely engulfing the black-clad man—

choices.memory_label: 提醒苏青瑶黑衣人意图

choices.description: Su Qingyao's strength is formidable, she doesn't need his words. Preserve energy to observe the battle, make plans if anything changes.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to demonstrate his value
choices.visible_reward: Don't expose himself, continue maintaining thetrash persona
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao falls into crisis, he might miss the best timing to support her

text.content: Chen Ji silently lowered his eyes, putting on an exhausted, powerless appearance. Yet his gaze never left the battle, his mind racing through every detail. Su Qingyao's swordsmanship was indeed fierce, but the black-clad man seemed to know her sword patterns by heart...

Between clashing sword lights, the black-clad man suddenly swayed, a muffled grunt escaping from beneath his mask—Su Qingyao's sword energy had finally wounded his shoulder. "You..." The black-clad man stumbled backward, his gazegloomy地 sweeping toward Chen Ji's location, "Today's matter isn't over." Before the words finished, his form had already transformed into black smoke, dissipating into the night.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, her gaze falling on Chen Ji in the well, her expression complex: "Able to hold on this long against him, you're tougher than I imagined." She paused, her voice dropping slightly, "But this matter is far more serious than you imagine." Chen Ji braced himself against the well wall,勉强站起, a bitter smile tugging at his lips.

text.content: "That organization is called 'Shore of Death'." Su Qingyao's voice sounded especially cold in the night wind, "They don't belong to the Three Great Sects, nor do they belong to the Demonic Path—they're a group of assassins drifting outside all forces. Rumor has it... they only accept commissions from one势力." Chen Ji frowned slightly, "What force?" Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then slowly uttered four words: "Heaven's Eye."

dialogue.content: Heaven's Eye—this name was like a basin of icy water poured over Chen Ji's heart. He recalled the transcendent existence Mo Xiansheng had mentioned—could it be that obtaining the Tianji Record from the beginning wasn't coincidental? Su Qingyao seemed not to notice his unusual state, continuing on her own: "I don't know what on you that they want. But from now on, between you and me... we must cooperate."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao proposes cooperation, Chen Ji must respond—should he be frank or continue hiding?

choices.description: Chen Ji decides to reveal part of the truth in exchange for trust, but the core secrets remain hidden in his heart. This aligns with his usual cautious style.
choices.visible_reward: Establish a preliminary cooperative relationship without exposing the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is extremely intelligent and may detect he's hiding something

dialogue.content: "Shore of Death... Heaven's Eye..." Chen Ji quietly repeated these two names, his face showing appropriate bewilderment and fear, "I'm just the most ordinary Servant Disciple in Tianqing Sect, why would such an existence target me?" He deliberately revealed the trace of the demonic path brand on his wrist, "As for this... I don't know where it came from either."

choices.memory_label: 向苏青瑶展示魔道烙印

choices.description: Since Su Qingyao has already saved his life, he might as well seize the opportunity to build a deeper trust relationship and jointly deal with the Shore of Death's threat.
choices.visible_cost: Completely exposed under Su Qingyao's scrutiny
choices.visible_reward: Form an alliance with the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, gaining a powerful ally
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao discovers he was acting all along, trust will completely collapse

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, finally nodding: "Su Senior Sister's life-saving kindness today, Chen Ji will forever remember. If Senior Sister doesn't嫌弃, I wish to join hands with Senior Sister and jointly resist the Shore of Death." Su Qingyao's eyes flickered, seemingly not expecting him to agree so readily, "...You're actually more sensible than the rumors suggest."

text.content: Moonlight like water, spilling over the abandoned well. Su Qingyao took out a jade bottle from her sleeve and casually tossed it to Chen Ji: "Healing elixir, take it first. Tomorrow at noon, come find me at the Listening Rain Pavilion in Tianqing Sect Back Mountain." She turned to leave, then paused, "Also... tonight's events, don't tell anyone. Including the Sect Master."

Chen Ji caught the jade bottle, watching Su Qingyao's figure disappear into the night. The demonic path brand on his wrist had already dimmed, Ye Qing's voice also falling silent. He leaned against the well wall, the four characters "Heaven's Eye" echoing ceaselessly in his mind. Tianji Record, Seers, Heavenly Fate Value... everything seemed to be manipulated by an invisible hand. "Shore of Death... Heaven's Eye..." he murmured, an unprecedented cold light flickering in his eyes, "Want to make me a chess piece? Then let's see who the true Chess Player is."
